address: Green Street, Saint Helier, JE2 4UH, United Kingdom
bio: If you have something special to celebrate, this marble-fronted restaurant inside The Club Hotel & Spa is the place to come – and cocktails in the bar are all part of the experience. It’s a chic place, where bright linen-clad tables stand out against dimly lit, dark wood walls. Eye-catching dishes offer natural, well-balanced flavours and an occasional hint of playfulness, while the kitchen clearly understands how to use techniques to enhance rather than overshadow the fine produce. Go for the tasting menu inspired by the chef's travels, with accompanying wines....
